{{Top|ca|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
An eccentric '''entrepreneur''' financed an expedition into [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]], a cluster of [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]]<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Into the Maw}}</ref> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> by [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Into the Maw" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> The purpose of the expedition was to attempt to [[Star map/Legends|chart]] a course through the Maw.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], an individual affiliated with one of the two rival governments in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], fought between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], sent a companion of theirs to join the expedition. The entrepreneur's journey into the Maw resulted in many previously uncharted [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] and worlds being catalogued while [[Map/Legends|mapping]] a course.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The entrepreneur was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Into the Maw" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="TOR" />
